quality_gate.note: The item-level reconciliation audit confirms seven genuinely new batch-074 AIDs, all selected as answer-eligible in seven distinct Evidence Families. AID 4731080 and AID 4812666 were already canonical in batches 059 and 058; duplicate batch-074 records were removed and the original families retained. Actual counts match the corrected expectation: 764→771 answer-eligible families, 761→768 content-verified families, 2,559→2,580 propositions. The readiness test now asserts seven new items, two existing rechecks, claim-level citations and researcher-mode evidence maps.

primary_user_question: עד כמה אפשר לסמוך על זה?
ux.default_experience: answer-first; technical provenance progressively disclosed; original source opens directly where lawful
ux.answer_model: proposition-grounded multi-source synthesis with high relevance threshold and numbered claim-level citations
ux.regular_mode: concise answer-first synthesis plus numbered evidence list
ux.researcher_mode: extended evidence analysis with subclaims, witness provenance, verification scope, context completeness, source-type/period/audience distinctions, Evidence Families, tensions and unanswered aspects
ux.language_policy: cross-language retrieval across Hebrew, Yiddish, English and any additional direct/authorized source languages; translations are derived, not independent witnesses
ux.precision_policy: precision over recall; lexical-only matches rejected; insufficient evidence is an acceptable result

verification_surge.effort_target: 75-85% promotion/verification until backlog is materially reduced; 15-25% breadth expansion
verification_surge.homogeneous_batch_target: 20-50 records when direct authorized item witnesses are stable and rights permit
blocking_reasons: metadata ambiguity or unresolved identity/dedup conflict

development_recovery.primary_bottleneck: Bibliographic identities are not inspected content; maintenance had no acquisition step and no content inspection.
development_recovery.required_agent_action: Continue original-language Hebrew/Yiddish witnesses and additional document types; treat English translations as non-independent witnesses in their underlying Evidence Families; preserve item-level locators and context limits.
development_recovery.last_run_note: Batch 074 inspected seven new Hebrew publisher letter bodies, rechecked two existing canonical identities (AID 4731080 in batch 059 and AID 4812666 in batch 058), and enriched existing AID 5357369 in batch 073. Added 20 new non-verbatim propositions across seven new Evidence Families and one additional proposition to AID 5357369; the two rechecked identities already had adequate propositions and were not duplicated. Four candidates (5413764, 5054497, 4754352, 4666220) redirected to rewritten summary shells and were excluded. The item-level reconciliation audit confirms all seven new AIDs are answer-eligible in seven distinct families. Actual readiness: 764→771 families, 761→768 content-verified families, 2559→2580 propositions. No crawler retry, access-control bypass, full-text copying, audience change or permission change.
development_recovery.last_batch_blocked_reason: AIDs 5413764, 5054497, 4754352 and 4666220 redirected to rewritten Torah Texts summary shells without item-level bodies. No propositions were inferred from titles or metadata; accessible alternatives were inspected in the same run.
